mapper.insert: INSERT INTO persona (nombre, primer_apellido, segundo_apellido, ci, telefono, email, fecha_nacimiento, genero, direccion_id) VALUES (#{nombre}, #{primerApellido}, #{segundoApellido}, #{ci}, #{telefono}, #{email}, #{fechaNacimiento}, #{genero}, #{direccionId})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT FROM WHERE ci = #{ci} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT FROM WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE persona SET nombre = #{nombre}, primer_apellido = #{primerApellido}, segundo_apellido = #{segundoApellido}, ci = #{ci}, telefono = #{telefono}, email = #{email}, fecha_nacimiento = #{fechaNacimiento}, genero = #{genero}, direccion_id = #{direccionId}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.email FROM persona p INNER JOIN usuario u ON u.persona_id = p.id AND u.deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN usuario_rol ur ON ur.usuario_id = u.id AND ur.deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN rol r ON r.id = ur.rol_id AND r.nombre = 'CLIENTE' AND r.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.deleted = FALSE AND p.email IS NOT NULL AND p.email <> ''
